audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is flatlined to 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already correctly has Tristana winning all 7 stages.
audit.why: Senna has low base attack speed, no mobility spell, and no self-peel on her global ult, so Tristana's range and reset-threat all-ins dominate every stage per the content whys — this is not a skill coinflip.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-6].side to Tristana to match the already-correct content win[] (no win[] edit needed), and rewrote each why to state the real, grounded reason instead of the generic jump-bomb-R template.

audit.why: Content spikes already correctly mark level 3 (dive her before she has stats), level 6 (Buster Shot breaks position, her ult has no self-peel), first item (attack-speed spike while she still farms souls) and late (keep denying her farm) as the swings.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags Senna's Piercing Darkness (Q) sustain needs a Grievous Wounds timing callout, and itemization only said vague 'anti-heal' with no item named.
audit.why: Q heals allies on hit, so chip trades let her sustain through poke unless anti-heal is timed against it.
audit.corrected: Named Executioner's Calling in itemization against her Q sustain.
